stanovnistvo.objasnjenje: How many people live here according to the 2021 Census. All per-resident amounts are divided by this number.

stanovnistvo_procjena.objasnjenje: How many people live here in mid-2025 according to the estimate of the Croatian Bureau of Statistics, counting migration, births and deaths since the census.
stanovnistvo_procjena.napomena: Mid-year estimate. Per-resident amounts are still based on the 2021 Census, because there is no newer estimate for cities and municipalities.

promjena_stanovnistva.objasnjenje: By what percentage the population changed from 2021 to 2025. A minus means more people died or moved away than were born or moved in.
promjena_stanovnistva.napomena: Change of the mid-year estimate compared with mid-2021 (migration, births and deaths).

gustoca_naseljenosti.objasnjenje: How many people live on one square kilometre on average. A high number means a densely populated area, a low one a sparsely populated area.

prosjecna_starost.objasnjenje: Average age of all residents. A higher number means an older community, with more pensioners and fewer children.

prosjecna_neto_placa.objasnjenje: How much employees of companies and institutions take home per month on average, after tax and contributions. Sole traders are not included.
prosjecna_neto_placa.napomena: Monthly average in legal entities, based on the JOPPD tax form.

zaposleni.objasnjenje: How many people have a job. Per resident shows the number of employed per 1,000 residents.

stopa_nezaposlenosti.objasnjenje: Out of 100 people who work or are looking for work, how many are registered as unemployed with the Croatian Employment Service.

neto_dohodak.objasnjenje: How much all residents together received in the year after tax and contributions: salaries, pensions and other income. Per resident it is the average per person, children included.
neto_dohodak.napomena: Salaries, pensions and other income after tax and contributions, for the whole year.

bdp.objasnjenje: The value of everything produced in Croatia in a year. The most common measure of the size of an economy.

bruto_dodana_vrijednost.objasnjenje: How much value companies, sole traders and public services in the county create in a year. Similar to GDP, but without taxes on products such as VAT.
bruto_dodana_vrijednost.napomena: Value of production in the county; GDP without taxes on products. The Croatian Bureau of Statistics does not publish GDP by county.

eu_ugovoreno.objasnjenje: How much EU money was contracted for projects here in the 2014–2020 period. Contracted does not mean paid out.
eu_ugovoreno.napomena: ESIF share of contracted projects, by place of implementation.

eu_projekti.objasnjenje: How many projects with EU funding were contracted here in the 2014–2020 period.

eu_2127_ugovoreno.objasnjenje: How much EU money has been contracted so far for projects here in the 2021–2027 period. The period is still running, and contracted does not mean paid out.
eu_2127_ugovoreno.napomena: EU share of contracted projects from the Competitiveness and Cohesion, Integrated Territorial and Efficient Human Resources programmes. Counties by project location (Efficient Human Resources by the beneficiary's seat); cities and municipalities by the beneficiary's seat. Projects of state bodies and projects without a location count only in the national total.

eu_2127_projekti.objasnjenje: How many projects with EU funding have been contracted here so far in the 2021–2027 period.
eu_2127_projekti.napomena: A project carried out in several counties counts in each of them.

hbor_krediti.objasnjenje: How much companies, farmers and the public sector received in favourable loans from HBOR (the Croatian development bank) financed from EU funds.
hbor_krediti.napomena: Five ESIF programmes of HBOR, by county of investment.

inflacija.objasnjenje: How much prices rose in a year. For example, 4% means that what cost €100 a year ago now costs €104.

saldo_proracuna.objasnjenje: The difference between revenue and expenditure of the whole state, including cities, municipalities and funds. A minus means the state spends more than it collects and borrows the difference.

javni_dug.objasnjenje: How much the state owes in total through loans and bonds, together with cities, municipalities and public funds.

lokalni_prihodi.objasnjenje: All the money the city or municipality received in the year: taxes, fees, grants from the state and the EU, and sales of assets. For a county we add up all its cities and municipalities too.
lokalni_prihodi.napomena: Budget outturn (not plan), latest year. For a county: the county budget and the budgets of all its cities and municipalities; for the country: the sum of all local budgets.

lokalni_rashodi.objasnjenje: All the money the city or municipality spent in the year: salaries, materials, services, support to residents and investment.
lokalni_rashodi.napomena: Budget outturn (not plan), latest year. For a county: the county budget and the budgets of all its cities and municipalities; for the country: the sum of all local budgets.

lokalna_ulaganja.objasnjenje: The part of expenditure that went into lasting assets: roads, buildings, kindergartens, equipment. It shows how much is being built, not just spent. We take the average of the last three years, because one large project can multiply a single year.
lokalna_ulaganja.napomena: Expenditure on non-financial assets (roads, buildings, equipment), annual average of the last three years of budget outturn. For a county: the county and all its cities and municipalities.

saldo_lokalnog_proracuna.objasnjenje: Revenue minus expenditure in the year. A plus is a surplus; a minus means more was spent than received, and the difference is covered by a loan or savings.
saldo_lokalnog_proracuna.napomena: Revenue minus expenditure in the year (without borrowing and surplus carried over).

udio_pomoci_u_prihodima.naziv: Share of grants in budget revenue
udio_pomoci_u_prihodima.objasnjenje: Out of every €100 of revenue, how much the city or municipality received from the state, the EU or other budgets instead of collecting it itself. A high share means more dependence on others' money, but it also includes EU money for projects.
udio_pomoci_u_prihodima.napomena: Grants from the state budget, the EU and other budgets (group 63) in total revenue (groups 6 and 7).

porez_na_dohodak.objasnjenje: How much tax residents paid on salaries, pensions and other income. This tax belongs to the city or municipality they live in and is its main own revenue.
porez_na_dohodak.napomena: Belongs to cities and municipalities; by the taxpayer's place of residence.

stopa_poreza_dohodak_niza.objasnjenje: The tax rate on income up to the threshold of the higher bracket, paid by most employees. It is set by the city or municipality, so a lower rate means more take-home pay.
stopa_poreza_dohodak_niza.napomena: The rate is set by the city or municipality. For a county and the country: average of cities and municipalities weighted by population.

stopa_poreza_dohodak_visa.objasnjenje: The tax rate on the part of income above the higher-bracket threshold, i.e. on higher salaries. It is also set by the city or municipality.
stopa_poreza_dohodak_visa.napomena: The rate is set by the city or municipality. For a county and the country: average of cities and municipalities weighted by population.

promjena_stope_niza.naziv: Change of the lower income tax rate
promjena_stope_niza.objasnjenje: Whether the city or municipality changed its lower income tax rate this year, and by how many percentage points. A minus means the tax was cut.
promjena_stope_niza.napomena: Difference from last year, in percentage points.

porez_na_potrosnju.objasnjenje: A local tax on drinks sold in cafés and restaurants. The money goes to the city or municipality.
porez_na_potrosnju.napomena: Local tax on drinks in hospitality; the highest rate where a range is set.

porez_na_nekretnine.objasnjenje: How much an owner pays per square metre a year for a flat or house where nobody lives permanently and which is not let long-term, e.g. a holiday home.
porez_na_nekretnine.napomena: Annual amount per m²; the highest amount where a range is set.

kupoprodaje_nekretnina.objasnjenje: How many properties (flats, houses, land) were sold in the year. It shows how active the property market is.

porez_na_promet_nekretnina.objasnjenje: How much the city or municipality received from the tax the buyer of a property in its area pays. The more properties are sold and the dearer they are, the higher the amount.
porez_na_promet_nekretnina.napomena: Budget outturn, account 6134 (occasional property taxes), which for cities and municipalities is the real estate transfer tax. For a county: the county and all its cities and municipalities.

prihodi_od_imovine.objasnjenje: How much the city or municipality earns from its property: renting out premises and land, concessions and fees for use.
prihodi_od_imovine.napomena: Budget outturn, group 642: concession fees, lease and rent of property, fees for the use of property and other. For a county: the county and all its cities and municipalities.

pravne_osobe_aktivne.objasnjenje: How many active companies, associations, institutions and other legal entities there are. Sole traders are not included.

javna_nabava.objasnjenje: How much the city or municipality contracted through public procurement in five years: works, goods and services such as roads, buildings, energy and maintenance.
javna_nabava.napomena: Total value of contracts signed in five years by the administration of the city, municipality or county (EOJN RH contract register), without its institutions and companies; kuna converted at 7.5345. For a county: the county administration and all its cities and municipalities.

nabava_najveci_dobavljac.naziv: Share of the largest supplier in public procurement
nabava_najveci_dobavljac.objasnjenje: What share of public procurement money went to one company, the one that received the most. A high share means reliance on one supplier; in small municipalities with few contracts this is more common and is not an irregularity in itself.
nabava_najveci_dobavljac.napomena: Value of contracts with the supplier with the most contracted money, divided by the total value of contracts in the same five years.

nabava_bez_objave.objasnjenje: What share of contracts was awarded without a public call to all bidders. The law allows this only in special cases, e.g. urgency or when only one bidder can do the job.
nabava_bez_objave.napomena: Share of the value of contracts from the negotiated procedure without prior publication in the total value of contracts in the same five years.

napomene: Boundaries are simplified for display (counties ~400 m, municipalities ~80 m).
EU projects are assigned to cities and municipalities by project coordinates, and to counties by the county named in the source.

tipologija.metoda: Machine learning (k-means, 5 groups) on five features of all cities and municipalities: population (log), net income per resident (log), share of grants in budget revenue, budget revenue per resident (log) and average age of residents. Features are standardised; the most similar by profile are the five nearest in the same space.

obiljezja.pomoci: share of grants in budget revenue

sredista.opis: The largest communities with higher income; the budget is mostly funded by own revenue.

mali-stariji.naziv: Small municipalities with an older population
mali-stariji.opis: Very small and the oldest communities; with few residents the budget per resident is high, but a large part comes from grants.

samostalni.opis: High income and high own budget revenue, with grants only a small part.

ovisni.opis: The lowest income of residents; more than half of the budget comes from the state budget, the EU and other grants.

prosjecni.opis: Close to the Croatian average in income and dependence on grants, with the lowest budget revenue per resident.

izdavatelji.HBOR: HBOR (Croatian Bank for Reconstruction and Development)
izdavatelji.Ministarstvo regionalnoga razvoja i fond: Ministry of Regional Development and EU Funds
izdavatelji.Narodne novine d.d. – Elektronički oglas: Narodne novine – Electronic Public Procurement Classifieds of Croatia (published by the Open Contracting Data Registry)

stanovnistvo.napomena: Mid-year estimate; includes migration, births and deaths.

neto_dohodak.napomena: Net income (salaries, pensions and other, after tax and contributions); 2022 converted from kuna at the fixed rate of 7.5345.

porez_na_dohodak.napomena: Income tax by the taxpayer's place of residence; it belongs to the city or municipality.

kupoprodaje_nekretnina.napomena: Number of sales per year (full years).

porez_na_promet_nekretnina.napomena: Real estate transfer tax in the budget (account 6134). For a county: the county and its cities and municipalities together.

prihodi_od_imovine.napomena: Revenue from non-financial assets in the budget (group 642). For a county: the county and its cities and municipalities together.

javna_nabava.napomena: Value of contracts of the city, municipality or county administration by year of signing (EOJN RH contract register).

proracuni_napomena: Outturn (not plan). County = the county budget and the budgets of all its cities and municipalities; country = the sum of all. Functions are for the latest year and exclude transfers to other budgets, so their sum is lower than total expenditure.

nabava.napomena: Contracts of the city, municipality or county administration from the EOJN RH contract register (without their institutions and companies). County: the county administration and all its cities and municipalities. Amounts in EUR, kuna converted at 7.5345.

eu_pozivi.napomena: Indicative plans of calls for 2026 (Competitiveness and Cohesion, Integrated Territorial Programme: October 2026; Efficient Human Resources: 3rd amendment). Eligibility is inferred from the text of the plan; the exact conditions are in the call.
